title: System Governance/System Governance - *.md spoke runtime body-structure contract
description: Hook-consumable runtime artifact for System Governance/ spoke files (one per pillar). Home for the SG_MAX_LINES size cap consumed by the pre-write-guard.sh size-cap guard.

_design_notes.consumer: hooks/pre-write-guard.sh (size-cap guard — reads .file_type_contracts."System Governance.md.json".size_limits.max_lines from foundation-master bundle; fallback to 400)
_design_notes.lockstep_pair: hooks/pre-write-guard.sh size-guard block (R-37 atomic lockstep) + governance/_index.json file-type-contracts pillar registry
_design_notes.evolution_protocol: R-37 atomic lockstep — runtime artifact + hook consumer + foundation-master bundle composition updated in one commit

size_limits.rationale: Navigational-index threshold. Spokes are the hub navigation; long content extracts to deeper spokes or sub-files.

mirrors_pillar_rationale: Each spoke mirrors exactly one of the 8 foundation governance pillars; R-37 lockstep couples spoke <-> pillar JSON <-> _index.json registry.
